contexts.text: As man is born... into the loves of self and the world, he cannot but be born into all ignorance and ignorance.
The intelligent of the world especially are in this ignorance.
The cause of this in science you may see above.
On account of the ignorance as to what love is...
Rider = ignorance from these things, by which it perverts truths.
That there is such ignorance and stupidity with those who have once embraced faith alone...
If these sin from ignorance... it is not imputed to them.
Such are atheists; some open, some clandestine, some ignorant.
